purpose: Teach: ヨット/カビ/就寝/ポッドキャスト/セルフ/時差/三位一体/皇太子

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがヨットの絵本をお持ちなのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad has the sweetest yacht picture book he's been wanting to show you.
lines.style: Warm, inviting tone. Gentle clarity in her voice—she's drawing Sho toward something small and precious. Slight lift at the end, like opening a door to something he'll want to enter.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お風呂のカビが嫌いだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I don't like the mold in the bathtub.
lines.style: Straightforward, matter-of-fact delivery with genuine worry underneath. Not complaining, just telling her something he's noticed and decided matters. Small, honest voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが就寝の絵本を読んで下さるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad says he'd love to read you a bedtime story tonight.
lines.style: Tender opening. Leisurely pace—she's giving him time to sit with the idea. Slight warmth on 'bedtime story,' like she already knows he'll like this. Trailing softly, inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ポッドキャストの子供番組を聴いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I listened to that podcast show for kids yesterday.
lines.style: Bright, simple directness. Pride in the telling—he's sharing something he did, something he tried. Quick pace, no hesitation. Wants her to know.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが食堂でセルフサービスを教えて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad taught you something really important at lunch today—how to help yourself at the counter.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost marveling. She's noticing something about his father's quiet teaching. Warmth beneath the surface. Gentle pace, like she's seeing the moment again as she speaks it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、海外旅行で時差ぼけしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I got really confused with the time difference on that overseas trip.
lines.style: Earnest, slightly sheepish. He's admitting something small and specific. Voice stays even—not asking for sympathy, just sharing the fact. Natural child's cadence, almost wry about his own confusion.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが三位一体の教えをお話して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad explained something really beautiful to you today—about the Trinity and what it means.
lines.style: Reverent, careful. She's handling something sacred. Slow, deliberate pace. Slight breath before the most important word, like she's making sure he knows this was a gift. Trailing into quiet respect.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、皇太子殿下の絵本を学校で読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, we read about the Crown Prince in a picture book at school today, and it was so cool.
lines.style: Bright, unguarded enthusiasm. He's excited to tell her something new he learned. Quick speech, words tumbling a little. Eyes open. Genuine child's joy at discovery and wanting to share it with her.
